items.label: Shades to Complement You
items.value: Available in multiple color tones designed to match your personal style and preferences

items.label: Auto On & Connect
items.value: The Go Air Tones+ True Wireless earbuds turn on and connect to each other automatically. Just take them out of their USB charging case for seamless, hassle-free connection. Then just connect the ear buds to your phone. Utilising Bluetooth 5.1, this is our fastest handsfree connection yet

items.label: Smaller Fit Ear Buds
items.value: Smaller than a credit card, the Go Air Tones+ buds case fits in your pocket and the Bluetooth earbuds are our smallest yet; 15% smaller and 40% lighter with the small case, than the Go Air wireless earphones. Suitable for the gym, sport or to carry while running. Try the three tip sizes to get a snug in ear headphones fit and creating a secure seal for crystal clear sound

items.label: Custom Sound
items.value: Download the JLab app to tailor your listening experience further. Control touch functions, adjust Be Aware settings, and personalize sound preferences with EQ presets including JLab Signature, Balanced, or Bass Boost

items.label: Battery Life
items.value: Listen for the long battery life with your wireless earphones; stay for the comfort. Go Air Tones+ features 9+ hours of playtime in each earbud and 26+ extra hours from the charging case. That's 35+ hours of playtime with your bluetooth earphones

items.label: Be Aware Mode & Google Fast Pair
items.value: Stay aware of your surroundings and let ambient noise in with Be Aware Mode for safe listening . Plus enjoy effortless pairing with an Android device and locate missing earbuds with Google Fast Pair
